requirements.title: Add task
requirements.text: The system shall let the user add a task by entering a text description which, after leading and trailing spaces are trimmed, is 1 to 200 characters long, and optionally a due date.
acceptanceCriteria: Entering text and confirming adds a new task to the list
The new task is shown as not done
An empty description is not added
A description consisting only of spaces is not added
Leading and trailing spaces are removed from the stored text
A description of 200 characters after trimming is accepted
A description of 201 characters after trimming is rejected
A task can be added without a due date
A task can be added with a due date, and it is shown with that due date

requirements.title: Mark task done or not done
requirements.text: The system shall let the user mark a task as done and mark a done task as not done again.
acceptanceCriteria: Ticking a task changes it to the done state
Unticking a done task changes it back to the not-done state
The done state is visibly distinguishable from the not-done state

requirements.title: Persist tasks on server
requirements.text: The system shall store tasks and their done state on a server so they are available when the user returns, including after the browser's local data is reset.
acceptanceCriteria: After adding tasks and ticking some, closing and reopening the app shows the same tasks with the same done states
After clearing the browser's local storage and cookies, reopening the app shows the same tasks

requirements.title: Run in browser
requirements.text: The system shall be usable in a web browser.
acceptanceCriteria: All features are usable in a web browser without installing additional software

requirements.title: Edit task
requirements.text: The system shall let the user edit the text and the optional due date of an existing task, applying the same trimming and length rules as when adding a task.
acceptanceCriteria: After editing and confirming, the task shows the new text and keeps its done state
The edited text is kept after reopening the app
An empty, whitespace-only, or over 200 character (after trimming) edit is rejected and the old text is kept
Leading and trailing spaces in the edited text are removed
When editing, a due date can be set on a task without one, changed on a task with one, or cleared
After editing the due date, the task shows the new due date, or none if cleared

requirements.title: Delete task
requirements.text: The system shall let the user delete a task.
acceptanceCriteria: After deleting, the task no longer appears in the list
The task is still gone after reopening the app

requirements.title: Done tasks display and order
requirements.text: The system shall keep done tasks in the list, show their text struck through, list open tasks before done tasks, and order tasks within each group oldest first by creation time.
acceptanceCriteria: A done task remains visible in the list with struck-through text
Every open task appears above every done task
Within the open tasks, the earliest created task is first
Within the done tasks, the earliest created task is first
Unticking a done task shows it without strike-through among the open tasks, at its creation-time position

requirements.title: Single user without login
requirements.text: The system shall serve a single user and shall not require login.
acceptanceCriteria: The app opens directly to the task list without any login step

requirements.title: Task due date
requirements.text: The system shall let a task have an optional calendar due date (date only, no time), which the user can set when adding a task and set, change or clear when editing it, and shall store it on the server.
acceptanceCriteria: A task without a due date is valid and can be saved
A due date entered when adding a task is saved with the task
A due date can be set, changed and cleared when editing a task
An invalid date is rejected and the previously stored due date is kept (or none when adding, no task is created)
The due date contains no time component
The due date is still present after reopening the app, including after the browser's local data is reset
Existing tasks without a due date still load and behave as before

requirements.title: Due date display and overdue
requirements.text: The system shall show the due date next to each task that has one and visibly mark an open task as overdue when its due date is before today's date in the user's local time zone.
acceptanceCriteria: A task with a due date shows that date next to its text
A task without a due date shows no date
An open task with a due date before today (user's local date) is visibly marked overdue
An open task with a due date of today or later is not marked overdue
A done task is never marked overdue, even if its due date is past
A task without a due date is never marked overdue
Unticking a done task whose due date is past marks it overdue
The list order defined in REQ-007 is unchanged by due dates

outOfScope: User accounts, login and multi-user support
Browser-only storage as the sole persistence

text:
I saved the update for TCK-001.

- **Out of scope:** I removed "Due dates". Priorities and categories stay out of scope.
- **REQ-009 (new), Task due date:** A task has an optional date-only due date. It can be set when adding, and set, changed or cleared when editing. It is stored on the server, and an invalid date is rejected. Existing tasks without a due date must still load and behave as before.
- **REQ-010 (new), Due date display and overdue:** The due date is shown next to the task. An open task with a due date before today's local date is marked overdue. Done tasks and tasks without a due date are never marked overdue. The REQ-007 list order is unchanged.
- **REQ-001 and REQ-005:** The text and criteria now mention the optional due date on add and edit.

I have no open questions.

Two things I noticed but did not change:
- **REQ-003:** The plan lists it as affected but has no step for it. Its text covers only tasks and done state, so I left it as is. The persistence of the due date is covered by REQ-009. If you want REQ-003 to mention the due date, say so.
- **Design and test items:** The IDs for UC, SEQ and DSN items (UC-001, SEQ-002, DSN-005 and so on) are not in this requirements document. I left them alone.
